title: Ethiopian Passion Fruit Juice
localName: ፓሽን ፍሩት ጭማቂ — Passion Fruit Chumaki
community: Ethiopian juice bars — the intensely fragrant fruit juice
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Passion Fruit Juice — fresh passion fruits halved, pulp strained and diluted with water, sweetened with honey. Ethiopia grows exceptional passion fruit in its highland areas — the concentrated aroma and intense flavour produce one of the world's finest fresh juices.
longDesc: Ethiopian passion fruit grows in the highland areas around Jimma and in the Rift Valley gardens — the fruit is smaller than commercial varieties but more intensely flavoured. The fresh juice, strained and diluted, is one of the most aromatic drinks imaginable.
steps: Halve passion fruits. Scoop pulp and seeds into a sieve over a bowl.
Press through the sieve — extracting as much juice as possible.
Mix passion fruit juice with cold water and honey.
chefTips: Press firmly through the sieve — much of the juice is in the sacs around the seeds.
Ethiopian passion fruit is very concentrated — needs more dilution than supermarket varieties.
cookingScience: Passion fruit's distinctive aroma comes from over 100 volatile compounds including ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate — these are present in extraordinary concentrations in Ethiopian highland varieties. The tartaric and citric acids produce the characteristic tartness.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian highland passion fruit — grown in home gardens and small farms.
culturalNote: Ethiopian passion fruit juice is the drink that stops international visitors — the concentrated fragrance of the Ethiopian highland passion fruit, diluted in cold water and sweetened with mountain honey, is one of the most extraordinary juice experiences in Africa.
